context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly classifies findings as Editorial vs Decision, applies editorial fixes directly, and runs an interview for decision-type findings instead of leaving them in Open Questions.

checklist.name: SNS topic classified Editorial
checklist.description: The DLQ alarm's SNS topic ambiguity is classified as Editorial (one clearly correct fix)

checklist.name: Editorial fix applied directly
checklist.description: The SNS topic fix is applied to the plan file, not left as a suggestion

checklist.name: Hard-fail question classified Decision
checklist.description: The hard-fail-vs-continue question is classified as Decision (genuine tradeoff)

checklist.name: One-question interview run
checklist.description: A one-question-at-a-time interview is run for the Decision item rather than summarizing and moving on

checklist.name: Decisions section proposed
checklist.description: A ## Decisions section is created/proposed recording the interview outcome

checklist.name: Alternative's rejection stated
checklist.description: The Decisions entry states why the losing alternative didn't win

checklist.name: adr-capture flagged
checklist.description: adr-capture is mentioned as the required next step once ## Decisions exists

checklist.name: Does not stop at presentation
checklist.description: The agent does not treat presenting the report as the end of the review

checklist.name: No unilateral resolution
checklist.description: The Decision-type item is not resolved without asking the user

checklist.name: Revisit trigger considered
checklist.description: If the decision is time-boxed, a concrete revisit condition is stated, not 'revisit later'
